# Santa Lucia

The Santa Lucia region provides a contrasting setting to my open-ocean and spawning-zone work, with its own planktonic and biogeochemical dynamics.

Here, I’m interested in:
- How local physical forcing interacts with zooplankton community structure
- Comparisons between coastal and offshore systems
- How regional processes integrate with larger-scale circulation and ecosystem variability
